summary: Formalize the full PTX 9.4 instruction language and computing model, and support proofs that GPU kernels implement TorchLean network specifications.
Explain the computing model and the conditions of each correctness claim through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted memory/collective models, integer and binary32 scalar execution, serialized storage and actual numerical kernels are implemented. A two-kernel scalar forward and a separately authored recomputing backward connect stored words to an actual pinned TorchLean graph and generated VJP, with existence and explicit numerical bounds. Reviewed Luna tasks establish bounded instruction capability. Full PTX coverage, mixed-source observations, general data-dependent concurrency, broader tensors/precision policies, concrete runtime/PyTorch correspondence and Gemma remain unfinished.
